==== role=serve invocation=Combined scope=User ====
[Unit]
Description=Iroh Tunnel (serve)
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart="/opt/iroh tunnel/bin/iroh-tunnel" serve run --config "/home/a b/it's & <cfg>/serve $$x%%i.toml"
Environment="IROH_TUNNEL_STATE_DIR=/var/lib/iroh $state%%n"
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5
RestartPreventExitStatus=6

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
==== role=serve invocation=Combined scope=System ====
# iroh-tunnel-pin config=/home/a%20b/it%27s%20%26%20%3Ccfg%3E/serve%20%24x%25i.toml uid=1000
[Unit]
Description=Iroh Tunnel (serve)
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple

Environment=IROH_TUNNEL_TRUSTED_UID=1000
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5
RestartPreventExitStatus=6

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
